lines.text: Do you know how your phone charges without a cable?
You drop it on the pad at night. No plug, no pins. And yet, by morning, the battery is full.
Look through both. A flat coil of copper in the pad, and another one hiding inside the phone.
The pad pushes current back and forth through its coil, over a hundred thousand times a second.
That makes an invisible magnetic field, flipping just as fast, reaching right up through the glass.
The field sweeps through the phone's coil and shoves its electrons along. Current, out of thin air!
That's why the spot matters. Slide the phone off center, and most of the field misses.
And some energy always turns into heat. That's why your phone feels warm in the morning.
Two coils, one invisible field. Now you know!
